entries.rawContent: Three architecture calls we're making today and not relitigating: 1) Auth provider — we're going with Clerk, not Auth0. Cleaner React-first DX and our scale fits the pricing tier. 2) Background jobs — adopting BullMQ on Redis. We tried Inngest, it's nice but adds a vendor dependency we don't want yet. 3) Email transactional sender — switching from SendGrid to Resend. Better deliverability metrics in our test sends.
All three locked in. Ship it.

expected.rubric: Pass when the actual extracted candidates contain exactly 3 items of type 'decision' (Clerk for auth, BullMQ for jobs, Resend for email). Tolerate at most 1 non-decision item if it captures something concrete from the thread. Fail if there are fewer than 3 decisions, or more than 4 decisions. Score 1.0 on clean pass (exactly 3 decisions, ≤1 extras), 0.6 if 2 decisions present, 0.0 otherwise.
